scope: Static review of the exact prepared revision only; no capture, provider, SDK, service, installation, or source-data access was performed.

blockers.evidence: capture() branches on info.st_size == 0 and creates an empty_database_marker without invoking SQLite or rejecting an existing WAL, SHM, or journal. The current preflight rejects only absent-main plus sidecar.
blockers.required_change: Refuse any present sidecar when admitting the empty-marker branch, including late appearance before completion; preserve the nonempty SQLite read-transaction/backup path. Add an owned synthetic negative case.

confirmed_source_properties: Nonempty databases use a SQLite read transaction and native backup, followed by closed-file integrity and exact whole-file bindings.
Configured agents are bound to the exact original configuration, with declared database and safety-file absences.
Archive filesystem must differ from both source and capture filesystems; key filesystem must differ from archive filesystem.
Original source and capture directory identities are checked during capture/backup; fresh restore authenticates their retained bindings without reopening the original paths.
All chunk authentication and original file-hash validation precede restore-directory creation; restored whole files are reread and SQLite is reopened read-only/immutable.
Private data and credential-dependent fingerprints stay in owned private files. The public projection contains counts and qualification boundaries.
The workflow retains one original total deadline, bounded phase deadlines, create-only outputs, and no automatic resume or retry.
Missing encryption dependency is refused before source configuration or database copies are opened.
qualification_limits: Static review is not actual Darwin execution, formal KV2 qualification, current credential validity, writer fencing, or cross-database atomicity.
Current test fixture uses Linux /dev/shm; actual Darwin controls require explicitly bound private fixture parents on two real filesystems and cannot be represented by skips.
The recovery key may share the source filesystem. No single-device-loss, power-failure, or independent key-replica qualification follows.

Archive and key directories remain bound to their original identities. The demonstrated recovery scope is loss of the original source/capture paths, not arbitrary archive/key relocation or reinstalled-volume recovery.
Generated candidate configuration only rewrites agentDir. It is not authority to start consumers; other configuration references require separate review before any client use.
